comments.author: @smile740
comments.text: I visited the island at the end of July. The views were absolutely beautiful and magical. The temperature was perfect — warm, but not unbearably hot. The scenery is breathtaking and something you simply have to see in person. 👌🌊🌊🌊🌞🌞🌞🫍🐬🫍🐬🌄🌅🏞️

replies.author: @themaps26
replies.text: July sounds like a magical time to experience Madeira! It truly is an island of eternal spring. Thank you so much for sharing your experience and for watching
